name: app.itmly/itmly
title: itmly
description: Let your assistant search, add, edit, lend, and import your itmly catalogue.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the signed-in person's items by text, list, category, or location. Archived items stay hidden unless list_type is archived. Results are paged. Only items the person owns or has lent out have a current_value. A wishlist item has target_price instead. Gifts the person plans to give are a separate list: they are returned only with list_type gift, which can be narrowed by recipient and gift_status (idea, bought, given). A gift has recipient, occasion, gift_date and gift_status, and no value: its current_value is always null. Every item also has display_value, the per-unit value that totals count: current_value when set, otherwise estimated_value, otherwise null. value_layer says which: confirmed (a value the person typed or accepted), market (a recent sold-listings value they have not accepted), estimate (worked out from the price paid and the purchase date) or none (no value yet).

q.description: Text matched against name, brand, model, category, description, notes, location, purchased from, lent to, borrowed from, tag names, and the name and description of collections the item is in. Everyday synonyms and singular or plural forms also match

list_type.description: Limit to one list. Omit to hide archived items and gifts. Gifts are returned only with list_type gift

recipient.description: Gift list only: who the gift is for. The whole name, in any letter case. Needs list_type gift

gift_status.description: Gift list only: idea, bought or given. Needs list_type gift

tools.name: list_items_missing_images
tools.description: List the signed-in person's items that have no photo, newest first. Items in the trash are left out. Results are paged. fill_missing_images adds photos to them.

list_type.description: Limit to one list. Omit for every list, gifts included

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get one item belonging to the signed-in person, including notes and tags. Only an item the person owns or has lent out has a current_value. A wishlist item has target_price instead. A gift has recipient, occasion, gift_date and gift_status, and no value: its current_value is always null. The item also has display_value, the per-unit value that totals count: current_value when set, otherwise estimated_value, otherwise null. value_layer says which: confirmed (a value the person typed or accepted), market (a recent sold-listings value they have not accepted), estimate (worked out from the price paid and the purchase date) or none (no value yet).

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the signed-in person's collections and how many items each one contains. A smart collection (is_smart true) only includes items that match its rules, so items cannot be added to it directly.

limit.description: Maximum collections to return. Defaults to 100

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one collection belonging to the signed-in person and the items in it. Item lists are capped.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List the distinct locations on the signed-in person's items.

tools.name: get_inventory_summary
tools.description: Totals for the signed-in person: item count, combined value, number of collections, and how many items are lent out. The item count and the value cover the items the person owns, including items lent out. Wishlist, borrowed and archived items and gifts are left out, and so is an item marked as borrowed from someone. Value is the display_value of each item (the current value when set, otherwise the estimate when there is one) multiplied by quantity. An item with neither adds 0. The price paid is never used as a value. The number is unformatted.

tools.name: get_insurance_export
tools.description: The items the signed-in person owns, as CSV for an insurance record. Items lent out are included. Wishlist, borrowed and archived items and gifts are left out. Optional filters: min_value, collection_id, location. Columns: name, category, location, collection(s), value, value_source, value_as_of, purchase_date, purchase_price, has_photo. value is the current value when set, otherwise the estimate when there is one, multiplied by quantity, unformatted. It is blank for an item with no value yet: the price paid is only in purchase_price and is never used as a value. value_source is "typed in" for a value the person entered, "Market value, confirmed" for a recent sold-listings value the person accepted, and "estimate" for a sold-listings value they have not accepted. It is blank when there is no current value. Missing data is a blank cell. The result starts with a line giving the item count and total value of the owned items that match, then the CSV. With no filter these totals match get_inventory_summary. An item marked as borrowed from someone is left out of both.

min_value.description: Leave out items whose value (unit value times quantity) is below this amount

collection_id.description: Limit to one collection, by id

format.description: Output format. Only csv is supported. Defaults to csv

tools.name: write_access
tools.description: Reports whether this connection can change the signed-in person's inventory. Changes nothing. Without write permission it answers insufficient_scope, which lets the assistant ask the person to approve write access. A user id in the arguments is ignored; the person comes from the access token.

user_id.description: Ignored. The signed-in person comes from the access token.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to the signed-in person's inventory and return the saved item. Sets the same fields as the app: name, description, collection, location, quantity, purchase price and date, condition, tags, notes, and list (inventory, wishlist or gift). A wishlist item takes target_price, not current_value: a current_value sent for a wishlist or borrowed item is ignored, and the result says so in value_note. A gift (list_type gift) is something the person plans to give someone. It needs recipient, and takes occasion, gift_date and gift_status (idea, bought or given; a new gift is idea). A gift has no value: a current_value sent for one is ignored and saved as empty, and no market value is looked up. A gift cannot go in a collection. A new inventory or lent item on a US dollar account gets one market value lookup in the background; the result then carries market_lookup: "pending" and market_lookup_note. Nothing is looked up for a wishlist, gift or borrowed item. A new inventory, lent, wishlist or gift item sent with no image_url gets the top suggested product photo straight away, using one image suggestion from this month's allowance; the result then carries photo_attached: true and photo_note. If no photo is found or the allowance is used up, the item is still added with no photo. A borrowed or archived item gets no photo, and an image_url you send is kept. The owner and timestamps come from the signed-in person, not the arguments.

current_value.description: Value of an item the person owns or has lent out. Ignored on wishlist, borrowed and gift items.

target_price.description: Wishlist only: the price the person is aiming for. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

list_type.description: The list the item is on. gift is something the person plans to give someone: it needs recipient, and it cannot later become inventory, lent or borrowed.

recipient.description: Gift only: who the gift is for. Required when list_type is gift. Ignored on every other list.

occasion.description: Gift only: what the gift is for, such as Christmas or a birthday. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

gift_date.description: Gift only: the date of the occasion, YYYY-MM-DD. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

gift_status.description: Gift only: idea, bought or given. A new gift is idea. given keeps the item on the gift list. Ignored on every other list.

inputSchema.description: Fields the signed-in person can set on a new item

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update one item that belongs to the signed-in person and return the saved item. Unknown fields and server-owned fields are ignored. current_value is only for an item the person owns or has lent out. On a wishlist, borrowed or gift item it is ignored and the result says so in value_note. A wishlist item takes target_price. On a gift, recipient, occasion, gift_date and gift_status can be changed: mark it bought or given with gift_status, and a given gift stays on the gift list. A gift has no value field. A gift cannot be changed to inventory, lent or borrowed; that is refused and nothing is changed.

current_value.description: Value of an item the person owns or has lent out. Ignored on wishlist, borrowed and gift items.

target_price.description: Wishlist only: the price the person is aiming for. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

list_type.description: The list the item is on. gift is something the person plans to give someone: it needs recipient, and it cannot later become inventory, lent or borrowed.

recipient.description: Gift only: who the gift is for. Required when list_type is gift. Ignored on every other list.

occasion.description: Gift only: what the gift is for, such as Christmas or a birthday. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

gift_date.description: Gift only: the date of the occasion, YYYY-MM-DD. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

gift_status.description: Gift only: idea, bought or given. A new gift is idea. given keeps the item on the gift list. Ignored on every other list.

remove_collection_id.description: Collection to take the item out of

confirm_market_value.description: Set true only when current_value is the number get_market_value just returned, unchanged. That reading is then marked as a confirmed market value. Leave it out for a number the person typed.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a collection for the signed-in person and return it. A smart collection (is_smart true) needs criteria with a list_type rule, for example { "logic": "and", "filters": [{ "field": "list_type", "operator": "eq", "value": "inventory" }, { "field": "category", "operator": "eq", "value": "Clothing" }] }. list_type is one of inventory (things the person owns), wishlist, lent, borrowed or archived. Without that rule nothing is created.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Update one collection that belongs to the signed-in person and return it. Changed criteria on a smart collection need a list_type rule (inventory, wishlist, lent, borrowed or archived); without one nothing is changed. A smart collection saved earlier with no list_type rule keeps its rules until its criteria are changed.

tools.name: update_location
tools.description: Rename a location on every item of the signed-in person that uses it. The first call describes the change and returns a confirm token. A second call with that token renames them.

from.description: Location name as it is now

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: move_items
tools.description: Move the signed-in person's items into a collection, out of a collection, or to a location. The first call describes the move and returns a confirm token. A second call with that token applies it.

collection_id.description: Collection to add the items to

from_collection_id.description: Collection to take the items out of

location.description: Location to set. Null clears it.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Move one item to trash. The first call describes it and returns a confirm token. Nothing is deleted without that token. The item can be restored from trash. This does not remove it forever.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete one collection. Items in it stay in the inventory. Only the grouping is removed. The first call states that, including how many items are affected, and returns a confirm token. Nothing is deleted without that token.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: lend_item
tools.description: Mark one of your items as lent to someone, with an optional due date. Records the date and adds the loan to the item's lending history. A gift cannot be lent.

tools.name: return_item
tools.description: Mark a lent or borrowed item as back in your inventory and add the return to its lending history.

tools.name: mark_wishlist_item_bought
tools.description: Move one wishlist item to the inventory as bought, and record the purchase date, the price paid and the store in the same step. It stays the same item with the same id; no second item is created. The first call describes the change and returns a confirm token. Nothing is changed without that token. A second call with that token applies it. purchase_date is YYYY-MM-DD and is today (UTC) when left out. purchase_price and purchased_from are optional. The price paid is not saved as the item's value: current_value is not written, and the wishlist target price stays on the item. On a US dollar account the item can get one market value lookup in the background, the same as on the website. Only a wishlist item can be marked bought. A gift, or an item that is already in the inventory, lent, borrowed or archived, is refused and nothing is changed. Mark a gift bought with update_item and gift_status instead.

item_id.description: The wishlist item that was bought

purchase_date.description: The day it was bought, YYYY-MM-DD. Left out, it is today (UTC).

purchase_price.description: What was paid. Optional. It is not saved as the item's value.

purchased_from.description: The store it was bought from. Optional.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: get_lending_history
tools.description: Lending history for one item that belongs to the signed-in person, newest first, plus who has it now.

tools.name: get_market_value
tools.description: Look up a recent sold price for one of your items, in your currency. Only for an item you own or have lent out: a wishlist, gift, borrowed or archived item returns an error and uses nothing. Draws on this month's market value checks and will not run once the allowance is used up. The check is counted after the lookup: a lookup that finds a value uses one check, and a lookup that finds no value is free, with charged false. From the 11th lookup with no value in one UTC day, a miss can use a check. The answer always carries charged, which says whether a check was used. When the same search was answered recently, that answer is returned with cached true and charged false, and no check is used. A currency other than USD is answered without spending a check, the same way the website does. When lookups are temporarily unavailable, or a lookup does not finish, no check is used. These checks are separate from the automatic value lookup an owned item gets when it is added, which never uses them. Does not change the saved value. Save a number you like with update_item.

tools.name: add_item_photo
tools.description: Read a photo and add the item, or fill empty fields on an item you already have. On an existing item the photo you send becomes its photo, replacing the current one. Uses one photo recognition from this month's allowance before the photo is read. Send the photo as base64.

item_id.description: Fill this item. Omit to add a new one.

tools.name: add_receipt
tools.description: Read a receipt and prepare an item for each line. Uses one photo recognition from this month's allowance. The first call shows what will be added and a confirm token. A second call with that token adds the items. Send the receipt as base64.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: import_items
tools.description: Import up to 500 items, the same limit as the website. A plain import is free. enrich uses one market value check per enriched item, the same monthly allowance as get_market_value. If the allowance runs out, the rest are still imported without a market value, and the result says how many were left unenriched. The first call previews the import and returns a confirm token that holds only a hash of the rows. A second call resends the same rows with that token. Imported inventory, lent and wishlist items also get the top suggested product photo, one image suggestion each, for as many as this month's image suggestions and the time for one call allow. The result says how many in photos_attached and photos_left. The rest are imported with no photo, and fill_missing_images can add photos later.

enrich.description: Look up a market value for each item, within this month's allowance

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: duplicate_item
tools.description: Copy one of your items. The purchase date is cleared so a later copy can be dated on its own. Tags and lending history are not copied. The owner and timestamps come from the signed-in person.

tools.name: restore_item
tools.description: Put one item back from trash. This does not delete anything.

tools.name: archive_item
tools.description: Move one item to the archive. It stays in your inventory and can be returned with unarchive_item.

tools.name: unarchive_item
tools.description: Bring an archived item back to your inventory.

tools.name: list_value_suggestions
tools.description: Suggested market values waiting for a decision, for the signed-in person. Accept or dismiss one with review_value_suggestion.

tools.name: review_value_suggestion
tools.description: Accept or dismiss one suggested value on an item you own. Accept saves the suggested number. Dismiss leaves the saved value as it is.

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.description: The signed-in person's notification preferences: warranty emails, and whether the digest is daily, weekly, or off.

tools.name: update_preferences
tools.description: Change warranty emails or the digest frequency (daily, weekly, or off). Other fields are ignored.

tools.name: bulk_edit_items
tools.description: Set the same category, brand, location, store, condition, list, or warranty date on up to 50 of your items. Every item must be yours or nothing is changed. The first call describes the edit and returns a confirm token. A second call with that token applies it.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: Files saved on one item that belongs to the signed-in person.

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Add a photo or PDF to one of your items. Send the file as base64, up to about 1 MB.

tools.name: remove_attachment
tools.description: Remove one file from an item you own. The first call describes it and returns a confirm token. Nothing is removed without that token.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: list_registry_claims
tools.description: Reservations on a registry collection you own. Guest secrets are not included.

tools.name: release_registry_claim
tools.description: Release one reservation on a registry you own, so the gift can be reserved again. The first call describes it and returns a confirm token. Nothing is released without that token.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token from the previous call. Without it, nothing is changed.

tools.name: suggest_item_image
tools.description: Find product images for one of your items. Uses one image suggestion from this month's allowance before the search, and will not go past the allowance. Does not change the saved photo. Each image comes with a token: pass the url and token to apply_item_image to save that one.

tools.name: fill_missing_images
tools.description: Give your items that have no photo the top product photo found for their brand, name, and model. Photos are saved straight away, with no confirm step; an item that already has a photo is never touched. Works on up to 20 items a call. Each search uses one image suggestion from this month's allowance. When the allowance runs out, the rest are reported as left and the call still succeeds. To change a photo use suggest_item_image and apply_item_image; to undo one use revert_item_image.

item_ids.description: Fill exactly these items, up to 20. Omit to take the newest items that have no photo

list_type.description: Limit to one list. Omit for every list, gifts included. Ignored with item_ids

limit.description: Items to work on. Defaults to 20, the maximum

offset.description: Items without a photo to skip first. Ignored with item_ids

tools.name: apply_item_image
tools.description: Save one image from suggest_item_image as the photo on one of your items, straight away. Send the url and the token that came with it. This replaces the current photo; revert_item_image puts the earlier one back. It does not use an image suggestion.

url.description: The url of one image returned by suggest_item_image

token.description: The token returned with that image

tools.name: revert_item_image
tools.description: Undo a suggested photo on one of your items. The photo it replaced comes back, or the item goes back to having no photo. A photo you uploaded yourself is left alone.
